heavy body 4 accelerated to very high speed during close approach
heavy bodies 2 and 4 closed to 0.36 distance, deep in softening regime with huge forces

counterfactual.change: reduced dt from 0.03333 to 0.001 with all else identical; smaller timestep resolves close encounter and energy stays conserved

explanation: With G=5 and dt=max 1/30, two 20-mass bodies fall toward each other (body 4 starts with vx=7 toward body 2). By step 2 they are 0.94 apart, by step 3 0.37 apart (softening length 0.3), so accelerations are huge and change rapidly within one outer step. The adaptive substepping (only 6 substeps in steps 2-3) is insufficient for leapfrog at this dt, causing large energy gain (~495 vs allowed ~168).
vision_note: The two large blue bodies at the bottom move toward each other across steps 0 to 2 and then collide and overlap in step 3. The three smaller bodies stay almost fixed while the colliding pair dominates the motion.
